method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 1,877 postings; 1,379 were older than 7 days, 71 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 152 were senior or excluded titles, 140 were not target roles, 57 failed Kenya eligibility, 13 were already applied to and 18 were duplicates. Remotive and LinkedIn failed (SSL errors), ReliefWeb failed with a parse error and the Jobgether API closed the connection, so those four returned nothing to the automated search. The automated Wellfound fetch is disabled by design. Browser passes (signed in, 20 Nov): Jobgether (about 110 listings reviewed from four searches, 1 kept), Wellfound (about 80 of 992 results loaded, 2 shortlisted; Cloudflare check cleared by itself), Fuzu (45 jobs in IT, software and data, 6 kept) and the MyJobMag personalised feed (about 25 listings, 4 kept). micro1 returned 67 roles, 4 of them new; the AI Agent Tester role is on the shortlist and the two machine-learning research roles are in the dropped list because no description was readable. Most Himalayas and Jobgether leads were mid-level, limited to Europe or the US, or posted weeks ago; the shortlist is short because few fresh junior-to-mid roles named Kenya or worldwide and had not been shown before.

stories.title: Anthropic debuts on Nasdaq after record $81.3 billion IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic (ANT) opened at $111.50 and closed at $97.17 on Nov 19, up 17% from the $83 IPO price, for a fully diluted market cap of roughly $1.8 trillion; it sold 980 million shares to raise $81.3 billion, the biggest IPO on record.
stories.why: The largest AI listing ever shows how much capital sits behind agentic AI and the Claude tools you code with.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens
stories.summary: Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window; Google says it ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index (58.6) and rolls out in the Gemini API and Google Antigravity.
stories.why: A new frontier coding and agent model with published API prices you can test in your own LLM and automation work.

stories.title: Grok Bot v1.2.3 adds per-tool permissions on connectors
stories.summary: xAI's changelog for v1.2.3 (Nov 18) lets connector pages set each tool to Always allow, Auto-review, Needs approval or Blocked, and says a routine that loses a connector sign-in skips its scheduled runs until you sign back in.
stories.why: A clear pattern for approval levels and safe stops in agent workflows, like the ones you build with n8n and webhooks.

stories.title: Musk says Grok 4.8 is in soft rollout, with general release one to two weeks away
stories.summary: Elon Musk wrote on X on Nov 18 that xAI did a soft rollout to some Bot users and still needs another week or two of polish before general release; Elonosphere notes no xAI release note names Grok 4.8 yet.
stories.why: The next Grok model is close but unconfirmed, so check x.ai before relying on it in a project.

stories.title: Everful raises $48.5 million Series A for AI-assisted factory sourcing
stories.summary: The San Francisco and Singapore startup, led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India and January Capital, says it ships over 5 million items a month to customers in more than 60 countries and will invest in AI to automate sourcing workflows.
stories.why: A well-funded company building AI workflow automation and Shopify integrations, the kind of team that hires engineers.

stories.title: Payhawk raises $280 million Series C at a $2 billion valuation
stories.summary: The U.K. spend-management fintech's round was led by Goldman Sachs' growth equity arm and brings its total funding to more than $500 million.
stories.why: A large fintech round showing money still flows to payments and finance software, your home sector.

stories.title: Nadella explains Microsoft's buyout offer to 60,000 employees
stories.summary: Satya Nadella told the DealBook Summit the buyouts were so people felt they had agency, said software engineering will thrive but the work has a new operating point, and that the team behind Cowork has just 11 developers.
stories.why: Shows how a big employer expects engineers to manage AI agents, which matches the skills you already lead with.

stories.title: WapiPay partners with Alipay so Kenyan importers can pay Chinese suppliers in yuan
stories.summary: Kenyan merchants send shillings and suppliers receive yuan through Alipay, skipping the dollar; WapiPay says it has processed more than KES 40 billion ($307.5 million) in cross-border payments across its network.
stories.why: A Kenyan payments integration story with real API and settlement work, close to your fintech background.

stories.title: Safaricom, MTN and Vodacom join TM Forum's fintech integration project
stories.summary: The Open Digital Architecture for Fintech initiative, announced at Africa Tech Festival in Cape Town, will build a common architecture and reference code; Safaricom's M-Pesa revenue exceeded KSh100 billion in the six months through September 2026.
stories.why: Shared integration standards could make connecting fintech products to M-Pesa cheaper and faster, which helps API and integration engineers.
